title: Wallet Frontend Configuration
description: Wallet frontend has extensive environment configuration options. These are consumed at runtime and used to generate the frontend configuration.

meta.label: Meta
meta.description: `meta` variables are consumed by the frontend at runtime through the `www:config` meta tag.

startup.label: Startup
startup.description: Used during container startup, for example to configure NGINX.

HOST.description: IP address the dev/build server binds to.

PORT.description: Port the dev/build server runs on.

APP_VERSION.description: Application version. Defaults to the npm package version.

BASE_PATH.description: Base path for asset loading. Used for sub-path deployments.

OPENID4VCI_REDIRECT_URI.description: Redirect URI after authentication/token request at the authorization server in the OID4VCI flow.

WALLET_ENGINE_URL.description: Engine URL for WebSocket transport. Falls back to WALLET_BACKEND_URL if unset.

ALLOWED_TRANSPORTS.description: Allowed transports (comma-separated in .env). 'direct' requires ecosystem CORS support.

TRANSPORT_PREFERENCE.description: Transport preference order; first available wins.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Browser console log level. WARNING: 'debug' may include sensitive data (JWTs/keys).

WEBAUTHN_RPID.description: WebAuthn relying party ID. Must match config.webauthn.rp.id in wallet-backend-server. Use 'localhost' locally.

OPENID4VP_SAN_DNS_CHECK.description: Verify the certificate SAN matches the response_uri in incoming OID4VP authorization requests.

OPENID4VP_SAN_DNS_CHECK_SSL_CERTS.description: Toggle SAN validation of certificates during OpenID4VP.

DELEGATE_TRUST_TO_BACKEND.description: Delegate trust evaluation to the backend AuthZEN proxy. Setting false is only allowed in development mode.

MULTI_LANGUAGE_DISPLAY.description: Enable multi-language credential display. Empty is treated as false.

FOLD_EVENT_HISTORY_AFTER_SECONDS.description: Fold history events older than this many seconds (default 30 days).

OPENID4VCI_MAX_ACCEPTED_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum accepted batch size during an OpenID4VCI flow.

OPENID4VCI_TRANSACTION_ID_POLLING_INTERV.description: Polling interval in seconds for transaction ID.

OPENID4VCI_TRANSACTION_ID_LIFETIME_IN_SE.description: Lifetime in seconds of transaction ID.

OHTTP_KEY_CONFIG.description: URL of the OHTTP key config endpoint.

OHTTP_RELAY.description: URL of the OHTTP relay endpoint.

VCT_REGISTRY_URL.description: URL of the Type Metadata registry for SD-JWT VC credentials.

POLICY_LINKS.description: TOS/policy links. In .env: LABEL::URL,LABEL::URL. Can be left blank.

SHOW_PWA_INSTALL_PROMPT.description: Show the PWA installation prompt on the login screen.

WALLET_COMPANION_INTEGRATION.description: Enable integration with the Wallet Companion browser extension.

PRESERVE_PRESENTATION_HISTORY.description: Keep credentials in presentation history even after they are deleted from the wallet.

SCAN_PHYSICAL_ID_ENABLED.description: Show the 'Scan Physical ID' entry point (native wrapper apps only) on the Add Credentials page.

OIDC_GATE_OP_URL.description: Base URL of the OIDC provider for the OIDC gate feature. Added to the CSP connect-src directive.

WELLKNOWN_APPLE_APPIDS.description: Generates .well-known/apple-app-site-association for iOS wrappers. In .env: <APP_ID>,<APP_ID>,... Can be left blank.

WELLKNOWN_ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAMES_AND_FING.description: Generates .well-known/assetlinks.json for Android wrappers. In .env: <PKG>::<FINGERPRINT>,... (map of package -> fingerprints). Can be left blank.

NGINX_SEC_HEADER_FILE.description: Path to the generated nginx security-headers config file.

NGINX_CSP_ENFORCE_RESOURCE_HTTPS.description: Restrict CSP resource (img) sources to https only. When false, both https and http are allowed.
